create_GGUFQuantizer: create a GGUFQuantizer instance with a quantization config to quantize diffusers models to GGUF format
validate_environment: validate that accelerate>=0.26.0 and gguf>=0.10.0 are installed before loading GGUF quantized models
check_quantized_param_shape: check that a loaded GGUF quantized parameter decodes to the expected shape for a model parameter
create_quantized_param: create and assign a quantized GGUF parameter to a model module with proper device placement
dequantize_model: dequantize a GGUF-quantized diffusers model back to full precision and restore original linear layers
